name: tokenomics
description: Make every AI token earn its keep: not just cheaper AI, better value from AI. spendlens tags sessions OPEX (run) or CAPEX (build); pennywise routes each prompt to the right model (cheaper for simple, stronger for hard), as a hook or a local routing proxy; diet stops context-flooding tool calls; budget sets daily and per-session limits in pounds; doggybag packs a cheap resume note into the project before the cache goes cold; coach and spend-report skills review your prompts and spend; bangforbuck measures cost per outcome; haggle quotes a task and holds it to an agreed price; sherlock finds wasted agent steps; waistline catches cost regressions (also in CI); tastetest proves a saving kept quality; springclean audits instruction files; groundhog breaks agent loops; splitthebill attributes spend by project, developer, agent, model and provider; bazaar finds the best-value provider; blinkers stops scope creep; crystalball simulates spend before adoption; deadwood reports spend on work that produced nothing; a live cost and cache statusline in the terminal (/tokenomics:statusline), the same line in the desktop app's band, and a dashboard (/tokenomics:dashboard).
